LanguageData.RR_Route_BuildBatteryDesc: Construct a battery on the gate's own circuit and charge it. The ordinary way, and the cheapest if the branch has steel and somebody to do the work.
LanguageData.RR_Route_BindExistingLabel: Bind a battery you already have
LanguageData.RR_Route_BindExistingDesc: Designate an existing battery as the gate's reserve. Nothing new is built; a battery that was already powering something else is re-purposed, which costs the branch whatever it was doing before.
LanguageData.RR_Route_AssembleOnSiteDesc: Run the assembly bill on the branch's own machining table and calibrate the result. Slower, and it leaves somebody on the branch who understands how the gate is put together.
LanguageData.RR_Route_RequisitionAssemblyDesc: Order the parts through the corporate catalogue and skip the fabrication. Faster and more expensive, and nobody on the branch learns anything from it.
LanguageData.RR_Route_SurveyAndAnalyseLabel: Survey a coordinate and analyse the book
LanguageData.RR_Route_SurveyAndAnalyseDesc: Send a crew through with a blank book, bring it home to a linked archive shelf, and put it through the laboratory. The intended route, and the one that earns insight as well as payment.
LanguageData.RR_Route_RecoverExistingRecordLabel: Recover a record already down there
LanguageData.RR_Route_RecoverExistingRecordDesc: Somebody else wrote one before you arrived. Find it, carry it out and file it. No survey of your own is needed, and you learn less about the coordinate it came from.
LanguageData.RR_Route_PlaceMarkersDesc: Set glow pods down at the junctions that matter and mark them as the route home. Three is what the company considers a minimum for a coordinate worth returning to.
LanguageData.RR_Route_CrewKnowsTheWayLabel: Your crew already knows the way
LanguageData.RR_Route_CrewKnowsTheWayDesc: A completed route log is proof that somebody walked it and wrote it down. The company will take that instead of markers, though the next crew will not thank you for it.
LanguageData.RR_Route_AnalyseDistortionDesc: Put a book through the laboratory that carries a record of the space misbehaving. The strongest evidence, and the only one that also advances the ladder.
LanguageData.RR_Route_TwoAccountsLabel: Two accounts of the same room
LanguageData.RR_Route_TwoAccountsDesc: Where a branch has a completed distortion log, the people who were there can speak to it directly. Cheaper than another expedition and worth less to the buyer.
LanguageData.RR_Route_CompleteFieldStabilityDesc: Finish the second rung of the ladder. The window gets longer because the branch understands why it was short, which is the outcome the company actually wants.
LanguageData.RR_Route_BuyTheWindowDesc: Order enough components through the catalogue to over-build the reserve and hold the window open by brute force. It works, it is expensive, and it teaches the branch nothing.
LanguageData.RR_Route_DeclareADirectionLabel: Tell them where this is going
LanguageData.RR_Route_DeclareADirectionDesc: Name the direction the branch intends to take and the company writes it down. Nothing is forfeited by choosing; the other directions stay open.
LanguageData.RR_Route_ShowThemByDoingDesc: Announce nothing. Go and meet something down there, write it down, and let the record speak for the branch. The company reads the file either way.
LanguageData.RR_Route_CommitToTheLadderDesc: Push the gate itself rather than the business around it. The branch that does this first is usually the branch that later regrets how wide the door was.
LanguageData.RR_Route_PurchaseDesc: Buy the shortfall through the corporate catalogue instead of recovering or building it. Available because the branch's catalogue carries this, and it costs money rather than work.
LanguageData.RR_Route_TestifyLabel: Have the crew account for it
LanguageData.RR_Route_TestifyDesc: Somebody on this branch has already been there and the log proves it. The company accepts a staff account in place of another expedition. Available because the branch has completed a log of the right kind.
LanguageData.RR_Event_ThresholdBleed: The space came out the near side. Whatever it did, it did in the room a gate stands in.
LanguageData.RR_Event_CorporationDelivery: The parent corporation sent supplies nobody asked for. It protects what it has money in.
LanguageData.RR_Event_FacilityRelief: A corporation clean-up team cleared the site, requisitioned a replacement crew and left supplies. The branch is open again.
LanguageData.RR_Relief_Body:
The parent corporation does not write off a branch it has on its books.
A clean-up team came in on all-access passes, removed {1} hostiles from the site and left. Behind them: {0} replacement staff and enough supplies to start again.
Nobody asked {2} whether it wanted the help, and no invoice came with it. The crew are on the ordinary wage from today.
LanguageData.RR_Event_ClearSquad: The Company cleared the laboratory, took its dead and its paper, and left three people to run it. Nobody was asked.
LanguageData.RR_Clear_Body:
Everyone at the laboratory went down. The Company does not lose a facility.
They came in on all-access passes and left no one standing: {1} of your people resolved on site, {2} of the dead buried or burned on the property, {3} structures repaired, every connection shut down at the gate.
The paper is gone. {4} credits of bonds were taken and will not be seen again, and {5} credits drawn from the account as restocking the petty cash.
{6} replacement staff are on the ground today, on the ordinary wage. The gate is still commissioned. {0} is open.
LanguageData.RR_Contact_CallDesc:
Tell the parent corporation this branch exists, and that it has a finding worth reading.
Once they have you on the books they start sending work, their clean-up team will come for a stranded crew, and their catalogue opens. There is no way to take the call back.
LanguageData.RR_Contact_Established: {0} is on the corporation’s books. Expect the first request shortly.
LanguageData.RR_Contact_AlreadyInContact: The corporation already has this branch on the books.
LanguageData.RR_Contact_NoConsole: A call needs a communications console this branch owns.
LanguageData.RR_Contact_NotOurs: That console is not on a map this branch holds.
LanguageData.RR_Contact_NoOperator: Nobody employed here is awake, present and able to speak.
LanguageData.RR_Contact_NoCoordinate: There is nothing to report yet. Find a way in and go through it first.
LanguageData.RR_Contact_NoFinding: You have nothing they want. Bring a record book back from a coordinate and have somebody analyse it, then call.
LanguageData.RR_Event_CorporationContact: The parent corporation has this branch on the books. It is now an investment rather than an experiment.
LanguageData.RR_Requests_NoContact: Nobody from the parent corporation has been in touch. Until they have, there is no work coming in and nothing here to read. Whatever this branch does next, it decides on its own.
LanguageData.RR_Requests_NoneOpen: Nothing is being asked for at the moment.
LanguageData.RR_Requests_PastTheHinge: The company has stopped naming things. It asked for six, it asked where this branch intended to take it, and it got an answer. What comes next comes from what this branch has become.
LanguageData.RR_Requests_DefMissing: A request this branch was working on is no longer installed: {0}. The record stays until it is cancelled.
LanguageData.RR_Requests_Bonus: Bonus if nobody on the books when this was accepted is lost: ${0}
LanguageData.RR_Requests_NoTimeLimit: There is no date on this. The company waits as long as it takes.
LanguageData.RR_Requests_RoutesHeading: Ways through this. Any one of them finishes it.
LanguageData.RR_Requests_RouteRowDerived: {0} {1} (open to this branch because of what it has built)
LanguageData.RR_Requests_HistoryCompletedWithBonus: {0} - finished by {1}, day {2}. The bonus was paid: everybody came back.
LanguageData.RR_Request_NotOffered: The corporation has not asked for that.
LanguageData.RR_Request_AlreadyResolved: That request has already been dealt with.
LanguageData.RR_Letter_RequestOfferedBody:
{0}
There is no date on this and there will not be one. Open the Operations tab, look at the contracts pane, and take it on when {1} is ready to.
LanguageData.RR_Letter_RequestCompletedBody: The company has what it asked for. {0} was finished by {1}, and ${2} has gone into the account.
LanguageData.RR_Ledger_RequestBonus: Request met with the whole crew intact
LanguageData.RR_Event_RequestOffered: The corporation has asked for something: {0}.
LanguageData.RR_Event_RequestAccepted: The branch took on the corporation's request.
LanguageData.RR_Event_RequestCancelled: The branch turned the corporation's request down. Nothing follows from it.
LanguageData.RR_Event_RequestBonus: The bonus was paid, ${0}. Everybody on the books when the work was taken on is still here.
LanguageData.RR_Route_ClientSurveyFileLabel: File the record you already have
LanguageData.RR_Route_ClientSurveyFileDesc: A completed route log is the paperwork, and it stays the paperwork after the crew who wrote it are gone. Analyse a record and the client gets what they paid for.
LanguageData.RR_Route_ClientSurveySpeakLabel: Put someone who was there in front of them
LanguageData.RR_Route_ClientSurveySpeakDesc: An employee who walked it and is still on the books can simply tell them. Cheaper than analysis and worth nothing the day that person leaves.
LanguageData.RR_Route_ClientSamplesRecoverDesc: Haul the metal home and let it sit where the company can see it. The slow way, and the one that leaves the branch knowing a route it did not know before.
LanguageData.RR_Route_ClientSamplesBuyDesc: The catalogue sells metal. The buyer is not going to test it, the company has already worked that out, and neither of them will mention it again.
LanguageData.RR_Route_ClientInstrumentsPlaceLabel: Set markers down and leave them
LanguageData.RR_Route_ClientInstrumentsPlaceDesc: Glow pods where the readings are wanted, and the company counts them as instruments. Nobody has to stay with them, which is the entire appeal.
LanguageData.RR_Route_ClientInstrumentsMethodDesc: Finish the second-reading work and the company has something it can licence to this client and the next one. More valuable to it than the readings ever were.
LanguageData.RR_Route_ClientRescueTrainingLabel: Train people to go in after them
LanguageData.RR_Route_ClientRescueTrainingDesc: Complete the rescue work and the branch has a capability rather than a favour. The company would rather own this than be owed it.
LanguageData.RR_Route_ClientRescueAccountLabel: Have somebody say what is in there
LanguageData.RR_Route_ClientRescueAccountDesc: An employee who has seen one of the things that live down there, and is still here to describe it, closes this without anybody going back in.
LanguageData.RR_Route_ClientAccessStandingDesc: Finish the standing-connection work. The client gets a door that behaves like a door, and the branch gets to stop treating every opening as an event.
LanguageData.RR_Route_ClientAccessPartsLabel: Hand over the parts and let them try
LanguageData.RR_Route_ClientAccessPartsDesc: Order the components and pass the problem along. Faster, and it teaches the branch nothing it will not have to learn later anyway.
LanguageData.RR_Route_RelayWorkDesc: Finish the relay project and the branch owns the capability rather than renting it. Slower, and the company stops asking about signals.
LanguageData.RR_Route_RelayPartsDesc: Deliver the components and let the relay be somebody else's build. Faster, and the branch learns nothing it will not need later.
LanguageData.RR_Route_CacheRationsDesc: Survival packs, out where the next crew will reach them before they need them. The cheap answer and the one that actually gets used.
LanguageData.RR_Route_CacheMedicineDesc: Order industrial medicine and put it in the cache. More expensive, and it covers the situation rations do not.
LanguageData.RR_Route_ShelterTimberDesc: Haul wood to the place it is wanted. Cheap, quick and exactly as durable as wood is.
LanguageData.RR_Route_ShelterSteelLabel: Buy steel and do it properly
LanguageData.RR_Route_ShelterSteelDesc: Order the metal and build something that will still be standing next season. The company notices the difference and does not pay extra for it.
LanguageData.RR_Route_LeaseWorkDesc: Complete the leases project and the branch can hold ground on paper. The company treats this as the real answer.
LanguageData.RR_Route_LeaseTermsDesc: Commit to the negotiated-terms work and the company accepts the intent. Declaring a direction is enough here; arriving is not required.
LanguageData.RR_Route_ResupplyStandingDesc: Finish the standing-orders work and the shipment stops being a decision anybody has to make. What the company actually wanted.
LanguageData.RR_Route_ResupplyBulkLabel: Just buy a great deal of food
LanguageData.RR_Route_ResupplyBulkDesc: Order rations in quantity and the question goes away for a while. It comes back.
LanguageData.RR_Route_EvacuationDrillDesc: Complete the return-drill work so a crew can leave together and on purpose. The company files this under things it hopes never to need.
LanguageData.RR_Route_EvacuationGuideLabel: Put your guide in front of them
LanguageData.RR_Route_EvacuationGuideDesc: An employee who has walked a route out and is still on the books can lead the rest. Worth nothing the day they leave.
LanguageData.RR_Route_WitnessAccountDesc: An employee who saw it, and is still here, speaks to it directly. The company prefers this because it can be questioned.
LanguageData.RR_Route_WitnessFiledDesc: An analysed entity record says the same thing on paper, and keeps saying it after the witness has gone.
LanguageData.RR_Route_MissingDetectionDesc: Finish the detection project. The company gets something it can sell to the next town as well as this one.
LanguageData.RR_Route_MissingAccountDesc: An employee who got close enough to one of these things, and came back, closes this without further work.
LanguageData.RR_Route_DangerContainmentDesc: Complete the containment protocol. Expensive, and the only route that leaves the branch able to do this again.
LanguageData.RR_Route_DangerHardwareLabel: Deliver the hardware and step back
LanguageData.RR_Route_DangerHardwareDesc: Components on the ground, and the problem formally handed on. Nobody involved believes this is a solution.
LanguageData.RR_Route_CargoDispatchDesc: Finish forward dispatch and the branch can move weight across distance. The company has already sold this.
LanguageData.RR_Route_CargoBulkDesc: Order enough metal that the shortfall stops being visible on anybody's paperwork. Ruinously expensive and completely effective.
LanguageData.RR_Route_StaffRecruitDesc: Complete the recruitment work and the branch stops running on whoever was nearest.
LanguageData.RR_Route_StaffBuyInDesc: Enough silver moves the problem to a competitor's hiring department. The company respects this more than it admits.
LanguageData.RR_Route_CombinedRecordDesc: An analysed distortion record of a place that stopped belonging to one family. The paperwork the company can put in front of a client.
LanguageData.RR_Route_CombinedAtlasDesc: Complete the coordinate atlas and the combination stops being a surprise. The company would rather own the map than the anecdote.
LanguageData.RR_Route_UnfamiliarRecordDesc: An analysed entity record of whatever is behaving consistently and wrongly. One account, properly filed.
LanguageData.RR_Route_UnfamiliarCorroborationDesc: Complete the corroboration project and one account becomes a finding. This is the version the company can charge for.
